mapper.insert: INSERT INTO question_bank (bank_name, bank_type, dept_id, description, status, question_count, create_by, create_time, update_time, deleted) VALUES (#{bankName}, #{bankType}, #{deptId}, #{description}, #{status}, #{questionCount}, #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{createTime}, #{deleted})
mapper.update: UPDATE question_bank SET deleted = 1 WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM question_bank b LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON d.dept_id = b.dept_id AND d.del_flag = '0' WHERE b.deleted = 0 AND b.bank_type = 'PRACTICE' AND b.dept_id = #{deptId} LIMIT 1
